text: Beautiful teeth at Dr. Aubonrut Dental.

I have visited Dr. Aubonrutt (periodontist) on the 07/08/18 due to my receding gums, to get a professional opinion on the issue. After the check up, she explaining in detail all the possible reasons for my problem, i.e made me aware of the correct brushing technique, the need for a guard against grinding my teeth and various other personal factors. After that she cleaned my teeth spotless, which took quite some time. Also the check up revealed multiple smaller cavities that needed fillings, which I did on a follow up visit.
Overall I feel confident about Dr. Aubonrutt's work practices and professional advice and I will continue to use her services.

To anyone who is afraid of painful dentist experience and do not have anywhere familiar to visit, I strongly recommend this place for your oral health care. I have had impact wisdom for years and the requirement of surgical extraction does not really encourage me to visit unfamiliar dentist even though I know the consequence of ignoring it can be excruciatingly painful. Finally under a close friend's recommendation I decided to give this Dr a visit while visiting Bangkok for a short vacation. I arrived her place without appointment together with my girlfriend slightly close to noon and thankfully she has no appointment that day. She did a full scan of me and my girlfriend and seen that we have much to do, she urged us to go for quick lunch. After lunch she wasted no time and started working with my girlfriend's teeth as mine requires more time. She girlfriend's work took slightly over an hour and she experience obvious skill superiority compared to the dentist back in her own country. As for myself, she took the balance of the time which is around 2 hours to polish, fill up a more critical fillings and surgically removal of 2 molars and 1 wisdom. The only discomfort I felt throughout the procedure was during the polishing and I have felt nothing about those extraction process. After the extraction and under her recommendation, I took a pain killer pill and that was it until I visit another dentist back in home country 10 days later to remove the thread for the stitches.
